subject: Evidence sprint onboarding + logs access for Brightline SIG
body:
From: Alan Bryant <alan.bryant@brightlinehealth.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Fri, 18 Jul 2025 15:23:00 -0700
Subject: Intro + request to run a short evidence sprint (CAIQ/SIG)

Hi Jasmine,

Thanks for the quick intro. Brightline is kicking off a SIG/CAIQ review for our vendor risk team and we'd like to run a short evidence sprint with Redwood to gather the artifacts we need (logs, configuration screenshots, CAIQ answers).

Top asks:
- A 60–90 minute walkthrough next week to map owners for each questionnaire section
- Samples of S3 access logs and a short extract of audit events for the last 30 days
- Confirmation on KMS key residency + a short note on key rotation cadence

I've attached our initial question list so you can triage ahead of the call (brightline-sig-questions.docx). Can you propose times? We're flexible Mon/Tue mornings PT.

Thanks,
Alan Bryant
Security Engineer
Brightline Health

---
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.inference.com>
To: Alan Bryant <alan.bryant@brightlinehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.inference.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Fri, 18 Jul 2025 16:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro + request to run a short evidence sprint (CAIQ/SIG)

Alan — great to meet you over email.

We can run a focused sprint next Tuesday (Jul 22) 09:00–10:30 PT or Wednesday (Jul 23) 08:00–09:30 PT. Which works better for your team?

For the call we'll bring:
- Irene (security/compliance lead) — will triage CAIQ/SIG ownership and evidence owners
- Aditya (solutions engineer) — will pull log samples and walk through access controls
- Marissa (customer success) — will coordinate artifact handoff and timelines

Pre-call ask: please upload the brightline-sig-questions.docx to a shared link or reply with a prioritized shortlist (top 10 questions) so we can pre-assign owners. We'll prepare an "evidence inventory" workbook and a playback recording after the sprint — provisional file attached: rdw-evidence-inventory-v0.3.xlsx (skeleton).

Also, quick note on KMS: we use customer-keyed KMS options for private deployments; for hosted accounts, keys are managed via AWS KMS under our control but offer rotation policies and CMK export is not permitted. Irene will cover the exact wording and where to reference it in CAIQ.

Best,
Jasmine Liu
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

Attachments: rdw-evidence-inventory-v0.3.xlsx (spreadsheet)

---
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.inference.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.inference.com>, Alan Bryant <alan.bryant@brightlinehealth.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.inference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Sat, 19 Jul 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro + request to run a short evidence sprint (CAIQ/SIG)

Alan / team,

Thanks — happy to run the intake and make the sprint as efficient as possible. Proposed quick agenda for the call:
1) 5m – Introductions & scope (which questionnaire: SIG vs CAIQ vs both)
2) 20m – Map owners to questionnaire sections and confirm acceptable artifacts
3) 20m – Logs/access: what exact extracts you need (S3 access logs, CloudTrail event types, auth failures)
4) 10m – KMS/keys, rotation, HSM/KMS customers options (what we can provide in hosted vs private)
5) 10m – Timeline & handoff (how we will deliver artifacts, DocuSign addendum if needed)
6) 5m – Next steps and acceptance criteria for closure

A few clarifying items before the call so we can prepare:
- Which questions in your doc are blockers vs informational? (Prioritize please)
- Do you need raw CloudTrail slices or aggregated event summaries? Raw slices require an NDA/secure transfer; we usually provide redacted extracts unless a private deployment is in scope.
- For sample logs, please confirm a time window (we typically provide a 7–30 day window) and any sensitive resource filters.

I uploaded the evidence workbook to our internal drive for the runbook: https://drive.redwood.ai/teams/security/evidence-inventory/rdw-evidence-inventory-v0.3

If you're OK with Tue 09:00 PT, we'll schedule and send a calendar invite with conferencing and an upload target.

— Irene Choi
Head of Security Operations, Redwood Inference

---
From: Alan Bryant <alan.bryant@brightlinehealth.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.inference.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: security-ops@brightlinehealth.com
Date: Mon, 21 Jul 2025 07:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro + request to run a short evidence sprint (CAIQ/SIG)

Thanks all — Tue 09:00 PT works for us (Jul 22). I've uploaded a prioritized top-12 questions and a brief on our residency requirements to the Doc share; attaching the original doc to this thread as well.

Quick answers to your clarifying items:
- Blockers: Sections related to data residency, export controls, and key management (we'll mark these in the upload)
- Logs: raw CloudTrail slices are necessary for our security team to validate retention and tamper evidence; we understand redaction needs and can accept a secure transfer method.
- Time window: 30 days is preferred; we'll exclude high-volume user-identifiers if needed.

Attached: brightline-sig-questions.docx (word list)

Looking forward to the call.

— Alan

---
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.inference.com>
To: Alan Bryant <alan.bryant@brightlinehealth.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.inference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.inference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jul 2025 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro + request to run a short evidence sprint (CAIQ/SIG)

Perfect — calendar invite sent for Tue Jul 22 09:00–10:30 PT (meeting ID included).

Pre-call asks (please before EOD Mon):
- Upload the prioritized questions and any residency docs to the HubSpot deal: https://hubspot.com/deal/BRIGHT-4521 or reply to this thread; we will not start the log extract until we have an approved transfer method in writing.
- If you need raw CloudTrail slices, confirm the secure transfer mechanism (SFTP with short-lived credentials or AWS S3 pre-signed with restricted IP access). Aditya will prepare a sample extraction process to review on the call.

We'll record the session and drop the recording and filled inventory workbook after the sprint (meeting-recording-2025-07-20.mp4). If anything changes on your side, ping Marissa and she'll reschedule.

Best,
Jasmine Liu
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced in thread: rdw-evidence-inventory-v0.3.xlsx (spreadsheet); brightline-sig-questions.docx (word); meeting-recording-2025-07-20.mp4 (recording, to be delivered post-call)
